label: empirical consistency, not instantiation

S53C.units: H is mean next-token conditional entropy at 128 fixed trigrams; exp(mean H) is the geometric mean entropy-effective size. Pool conditional supports count all matching trigram windows. Global continuation support is a different statistic.
S53C.boundary: Ancestral occurrences within autoregressive sequences are not iid per-context pools. Softmax Q/V fitting is not saturated categorical fitting with declared final additive smoothing.

S54.boundary: The log8 threshold is a predeclared empirical event threshold, not a proved smoothing floor.

S55_instrument_boundary: Original frozen analyzer FAIL_INSTRUMENT retained; separate int32/int64 compatibility repair passed. Statistical rules unchanged.
